description: Subscribes an email address to one city's free daily digest. A welcome email goes out at once and the first edition is generated and sent within minutes; every edition carries a one-click unsubscribe. Free, no account. This sends mail to the address given — only call it for an address whose owner asked to subscribe, and confirm with them first. An address can hold up to 10 city digests; subscribing to a second city adds it, never replaces the first.

email.description: The reader's email address. Only subscribe an address whose owner asked for this — the tool sends mail to it.

name: subscribe_city
title: Subscribe a reader to a city's daily digest
